Need a hand?

Frequently asked questions.

Answers from the academy guide. Contact us if you need help with a specific course.

What is the refund policy?

Cancel 7 or more days before the first session for a full refund. Cancel 3–6 days before for a 50% refund or a free transfer. Cancellations within 2 days of the first session, and no-shows, are not refunded.

Are ingredients and equipment included?

Yes. Course fees cover ingredients, equipment and aprons. Your course guide lists any special items to bring.

Can you accommodate allergies?

Tell us when you sign up. We can often substitute an ingredient, but our kitchens handle common allergens and cannot guarantee an allergen-free environment. BAK-104 Macaron Masterclass is not suitable for nut allergies.

How do I sign up?

Choose a course and use its Sign up button, or email enrol@cookbakeacademy.sg.
